snippet.title: StreetPass Mii Plaza - Mii Force / StreetPass Squad - Arcade Mode (Normal)
snippet.description:
In Arcade Mode, this is mostly a survival mode to see how far you can go with the squad you have with the use of StreetPass or spending on Play Coins. The challenge for this is that you are playing all the levels once again from the story mode and see how far you can go with the Mii Force team you have. There are no turbo gems in this mode. In other words, you are not able to be invincible for a short time. Relying on the team that you currently have is the best advice I can give and take use of their abilities in the levels they're best at. Clearing the Arcade Mode will earn you a Plaza Ticket. 

In normal mode, you will start off with 3 members of your squad on the first level. In order to gather more members of your squad scattered in this mode, you must clear levels and progress. If you lose your current members of your squad, then you will retry the level you are at currently with 3 more members of your squad. Depending on how many mercenaries you have left from the use of StreetPass or Play Coins are the number of attempts you can retry before you fail the mission. 

Here are the timestamps...
1:30 - Platinum Beach 1-1 (You get the first three members of your squad)
4:09 - Dunewatch Castle 1-2
7:09 - Cerulean Tower 1-3
9:51 - Ragnablok Chasm 2-1 (You get the fourth member of your squad)
12:39 - Roohin Plaza 2-2 (You get the fifth member of your squad)
15:34 - Slitherstone Ruins 2-3
19:47 - Parade o' Plunder 3-1 (You get the sixth member of your squad)
23:42 - Bone Rattler 3-2 (You get the seventh member of your squad)
26:29 - Wheels of Woe 3-3
30:38 - Nautilus Nest 4-1 (You get the eighth member of your squad)
33:48 - Amethyst Atoll 4-2 (You get the ninth member of your squad)
36:53 - Prospectors Trench 4-3
41:47 - GB-1 Space Dock 5-1 (You get the final member of your squad)
46:22 - GB-1 Central Core 5-2
51:00 - Goldie VII 5-3
57:28 - All Missions Cleared
58:14 - The List of All Reputations (North American Version)
59:13 - All Plaza Tickets Collected In This Game

This was by far the hardest challenge I had to do in StreetPass Mii Plaza. I might be exaggerating on that, but this was too frustrating to just clear entirely for a Plaza Ticket. This took me several attempts to do it only because the water levels were the most annoying to clear. This was a miracle that I kept my squad that I had when entering the final world. This is the challenge where you must remember each and every level and how the enemies are going to appear if you wish to have an easier time in clearing this mode. I'm not going to do hard mode since this was too frustrating to deal with. I've mostly done this to get the last few Plaza tickets to fully complete the StreetPass Games once and for all.
